title: Share only what the customer should see
description: Review the receipt before opening WhatsApp.
customerOnly: Content comes from the original sale receipt; it excludes costs, margins, and internal data.
manualSend: Puntovivo opens WhatsApp with prepared text, but it does not choose the contact or send the message.
localImage: The image downloads to this device. Attach it manually in WhatsApp.
loadError: We could not prepare the receipt for sharing. Try again.
imageReady: Image downloaded. Attach the file to the conversation before sending.
imageFallback: The image is unavailable. You can continue with the prepared WhatsApp text.
